description: This file contains utility functions, classes, and policies for automatic module wrapping in PyTorch's Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) framework, including policies for auto-wrapping modules based on size, class, or custom functions, as well as context managers for wrapping configuration.

classes.name: _Policy
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a policy for applying a module-level API in FSDP auto-wrapping.

classes.name: ModuleWrapPolicy
classes.description: Policy class that applies to modules of specified classes, passing in root kwargs for wrapping.

classes.name: CustomPolicy
classes.description: Policy class that uses a lambda function to determine wrapping behavior for modules.

classes.name: _ConfigAutoWrap
classes.description: Helper class managing context for automatic module wrapping configuration.

methods.name: _post_order_apply
methods.description: Applies a function to every module in a module tree following post-order traversal, replacing modules if the function returns a new module.

methods.name: _construct_wrap_fn
methods.description: Constructs a wrap function based on target modules and kwargs, to be used with post-order application.

methods.name: _run_mixed_precision_override_policy
methods.description: Overrides policies for modules of certain classes to enforce mixed precision settings.

methods.name: always_wrap_policy
methods.description: Policy that always returns True, wrapping all submodules.

methods.name: _run_policy
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, returning a mapping of modules to their wrap kwargs.

methods.name: _module_wrap_policy
methods.description: Auto wrap policy that wraps modules of specified classes, always recursing on the root.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Invokes the wrap policy for a module, deciding whether to wrap based on class.

methods.name: lambda_auto_wrap_policy
methods.description: Auto wrap policy based on a user-defined function, always recursing.

methods.name: transformer_auto_wrap_policy
methods.description: Auto wrap policy for transformer models, wrapping shared parameters together.

methods.name: _wrap_module_cls_individually
methods.description: Wraps modules individually based on class membership.

methods.name: _or_policy
methods.description: Combines multiple policies, wrapping if any policy returns True.

methods.name: size_based_auto_wrap_policy
methods.description: Size-based auto wrap policy, wrapping modules exceeding a parameter count threshold, with options to exclude or force leaf modules.

methods.name: enable_wrap
methods.description: Context manager to set up automatic wrapping configuration for modules.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Function to annotate modules for wrapping within an enable_wrap context, applying configured wrapper class and kwargs.

methods.name: _wrap
methods.description: Internal function to wrap a module with a specified wrapper class and overrides.

methods.name: _recursive_wrap
methods.description: Recursively wraps submodules of a module based on an auto wrap policy, returning the wrapped module and count.
